title: 第二十一章 先导片发布第二十二章 幻梦
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工

“我们这是要去哪？”跟在林奇身后的尤里安好奇的问道。
“去地下室。”林奇身前的薇奥拉解答道。
“去地下室为什么要上楼？”林奇好奇的问。
“因为地下室的入口在楼上啊。”
淦！我说怎么一直找不到，合着地下室的入口居然在三楼？正常的地下室都是从一楼进入，而迪迪埃庄园的地下室却是通过三楼进入的。
坏处是要走很长的楼梯才能到达地下室，好处是一般人找不到这个地方。
“你说的是这个吗？”在地下室的薇奥拉递给了林奇一个水晶球。
“面板。”林奇接过之后心中默念。
名称：【梦魇之声】
类型：【八音盒】
级别：【a级禁物】
能力：【1、幻梦沉沦：拧动发条后，八音盒将以自身为中心展开半径约五十米的强制入眠领域。除持握者外，范围内所有生命体将陷入不可抗拒的深层睡眠。沉睡十小时时限者，其梦境将彻底吞噬现实感知，肉体虽存活，但意识永远滞留于梦魇层，成为活体睡美人。】
【2、另界：持握者将获得无限清醒的生理特质，不再需要自然睡眠。而当持握者主动选择入睡时，意识将进入一个完全由其自身潜意识构建的独有梦境世界。】
代价：使用者在12小时内分不清现实和梦境。
介绍：当旋律响起，清醒便成了一种奢侈。
居然是这样么，上一世林奇就很好奇，分不清现实和梦境的薇奥拉怎么没被饿死还成为了序列8，这另界完全就是一个bug，一个完全由持有者所想的世界里面的一切基本真实，持有者不需要睡眠则相当于多出一倍的修炼时间！
“这个八音盒你每天都在用吗？”林奇问道。
“抱歉，这个是我姐姐送我的，我不知道是你未婚妻的定情信物，我每天都会用它入睡。”薇奥拉有些羞涩的低下了头。
反正是梦境，把八音盒送给他也无所谓的吧，回到现实我还有一个。

“我明白了，24小时后再来找我吧。”林奇深深的看了薇奥拉一眼说道。
“什么啊，你们干嘛要住在我家里，喂！”
三人在薇奥拉的驱赶声中离开了地下室。
“这是个禁物？”尤里安好奇的看着林奇手中的八音盒问道。
“对，能力是能让一定范围的人陷入沉睡，同时持有者将不需要睡眠，在睡眠时会进入八音盒内部，那里有一个小世界随持有者所想而变化。”林奇打量着水晶球内部的景色说道。
“居然有一个世界？这么强吗？”尤里安有些惊讶，来自小村庄的尤里安并没有见过什么世面。
“代价也同样很大，使用者将分不清两个世界。”林奇对着尤里安泼了一盆冷水。
“所以她是......”
“没错，她以为这一切都是梦。”
“所以你才让她明天再来找你啊......”尤里安想着那个跟他妹妹一般年纪的少女沉默了下来。
“希望她听到真相之后能挺过来。”
林奇回到了卧室将梦魇之声摆在了房间的桌子上，同时从系统背包里取出了一些禁物。
名称：【嫉妒】
类型：【长剑】
级别：【b级禁物】
能力：【1、持剑者可凭意念在两种形态中自由切换（直剑软剑）】
代价：持剑者使用时必须清晰、响亮的喊出禁物的名称以及能力。
介绍：它憎恨一切单一的存在，因而永远为自己备好另一副面孔。
名称：【莽夫之握】

"Where are we going?" Julian, who was following Lynch, asked curiously.
"Go to the basement." Viola in front of Lynch answered.
"Why do you have to go upstairs when you go to the basement?" Lynch asked curiously.
"Because the entrance to the basement is upstairs."
Gan! I asked why I couldn't find it. The entrance to the basement is actually on the third floor? Normal basements are entered from the first floor, but the basement of Didier Manor is entered through the third floor.
The disadvantage is that you have to walk up a long set of stairs to get to the basement, the advantage is that the average person cannot find this place.
"Is this what you're talking about?" Viola in the basement handed Lynch a crystal ball.
"Panel." Lin Qi muttered silently after taking it.
Name: [Nightmare Sound]
Type: [Music Box]
Level: [A-level forbidden object]
Ability: [1. Falling into Dreams: After twisting the clockwork, the music box will expand a forced sleep field with a radius of about fifty meters centered on itself. Except for the holder, all living creatures within the range will fall into an irresistible deep sleep. For those who sleep for ten hours, their dreams will completely swallow up their perception of reality. Although their bodies will survive, their consciousness will remain in the nightmare layer forever, becoming a living sleeping beauty. 】
[2. Another world: The holder will obtain the physiological characteristics of infinite wakefulness and no longer need to sleep naturally. And when the holder actively chooses to fall asleep, his consciousness will enter a unique dream world completely constructed by his own subconscious mind. 】
Price: The user cannot distinguish between reality and dreams for 12 hours.
Introduction: When the melody sounds, sobriety becomes a luxury.
Is this actually the case? Lynch was very curious in the last life. How could Viola, who couldn't distinguish between reality and dreams, not starve to death and become a Sequence 8? This other world is completely a bug. Everything in the world is completely determined by the holder's imagination. Everything in the world is basically real. The holder does not need to sleep, which is equivalent to doubling the training time!
"Do you use this music box every day?" Lynch asked.
"Sorry, my sister gave this to me. I didn't know it was your fiancée's token of love. I use it to sleep every day." Viola lowered her head shyly.
It's a dream anyway, so it doesn't matter if I give him the music box. When I return to reality, I still have one.
"I understand, come back to me in 24 hours." Lynch looked at Viola deeply and said.
"What, why do you want to live in my house? Hey!"
The three of them left the basement amidst Viola's expulsion.
"Is this a forbidden object?" Julian asked curiously as he looked at the music box in Lynch's hand.
"Yes, the ability can make people within a certain range fall into deep sleep. At the same time, the holder will not need to sleep. When sleeping, he will enter the inside of the music box. There is a small world there that changes according to the holder's thoughts." Lynch looked at the scenery inside the crystal ball and said.
"There is actually a world? Is it so powerful?" Julian was a little surprised. Julian, who came from a small village, had not seen much of the world.
"The price is also very high. The user will not be able to distinguish between the two worlds." Lynch poured cold water on Julian.
"So she is..."
"Yes, she thought it was all a dream."
"That's why you asked her to come back to you tomorrow..." Julian fell silent thinking about the girl who was about the same age as his sister.
"Hopefully she will come through after hearing the truth."
Lynch returned to the bedroom and placed the Nightmare Sound on the table in the room, while taking out some forbidden items from the system backpack.
Name: [Jealousy]
Type: [Long Sword]
Level: [B-level prohibited items]
Ability: [1. The sword holder can freely switch between two forms (straight sword and soft sword) with his thoughts]
Price: The sword wielder must shout the name and ability of the forbidden object clearly and loudly when using it.
Introduction: It hates all single existences, so it always prepares for itselfWhat a different face.
Name: [Reckless Man’s Grip]
